svg.title: edshield agent loop, in detail
svg.text: Two AI agents improve a student-privacy filter. A fixed judge scores every attempt. A human has the last word.
writes the test bench and its 43 tests
reads each report, writes the diagnosis
proposes rule changes on a branch
runs every measurement, seals test sets
INSIDE EDSHIELD · THE SYSTEM BEING IMPROVED
what the agents may change, cheapest first
today: rules + a retrained model with 2 new labels
THE MEASUREMENT · WHAT ONE RUN OF THE BENCH DOES
every try is measured the same way
what still gets through, by type: the next try starts here
GUARDRAILS · WHAT KEEPS THE LOOP HONEST
Never worse than the released version on the 680 real essays
Training text shares no 4-word phrase with either test's wording
A trial result can never lower the bar for the next trial
Real essays and model files stay on the PC; only scores are uploaded
Stops after 12 experiments, 20 GPU-hours, or two rounds with no gain
pass mark: 99.5% of identifiers removed overall · 98% for every type
good enough on the practice sets?
Every run leaves a report and a ledger row.
Each row carries fingerprints of the data, the pass marks, the code and the model, so a result can be traced and re-run.
